overall_goal: Cook the plant-based burger strips while managing ingredients, checking potatoes, and cleaning up

goals.rationale: The person clears the chopping board and seasons the plant-based burger strips on a plate.
The person washes and dries their hands at the sink after handling the seasoned burger.

goals.description: Check the potatoes and adjust the hob heat
goals.rationale: The person uses a wooden spoon to check the doneness of the potatoes in the saucepan and adjusts the heat.

goals.description: Add sunflower oil to the frying pan and turn on the hob
goals.rationale: The person retrieves sunflower oil, measures and pours it into the frying pan, closes the bottle, and turns on the hob.

goals.description: Add the seasoned plant-based burger to the frying pan and start cooking
goals.rationale: The person finds a spatula, adds the seasoned burger to the frying pan, and begins stirring it while adjusting the extractor fan and heat.

goals.description: Stir the plant-based burger and check the recipe
goals.rationale: The person continues to stir the burger to ensure even cooking, occasionally checking the recipe card and adjusting the heat.

goals.description: Open the butter packaging and stir the plant-based burger
goals.rationale: The person retrieves and opens the butter packaging, then resumes stirring the plant-based burger.
The person washes the plate used for the burger with a sponge, rinses it, and dries it with a cloth.

goals.description: Wrap the butter and store it in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person wraps the remaining butter and stores it in the fridge.

goals.description: Add chopped onion to the pan and retrieve sour cream from the fridge
goals.rationale: The person adds chopped onion to the pan, adjusts the saucepan, and retrieves sour cream from the fridge.

goals.description: Put away the sunflower oil bottle, dry hands, and manage utensils
goals.rationale: The person puts away the sunflower oil, dries their hands, and manages utensils on the kitchen top.
